# flightdeck_label (Resource)

Manages a label within a Flightdeck project.

A new project comes with starter labels (Bug, Feature, Enhancement, Documentation, Tech debt); import one to manage it.

Import by numeric id: `terraform import flightdeck_label.bug 23`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "flightdeck_project" "app" {
  name       = "Mobile App"
  identifier = "APP"
}

resource "flightdeck_label" "security" {
  project_id = flightdeck_project.app.id
  name       = "Security"
  color      = "#dc2626"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Display name; unique within the project.
- `project_id` (Number) Id of the project the label belongs to. Changing it replaces the label.

### Optional

- `color` (String) Hex color (`#rgb` or `#rrggbb`, compared case-insensitively). Defaults to the server's default.

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) Numeric id of the label.
- `lock_version` (Number) Optimistic-locking version the API bumps on every change. Sent as `If-Match` on updates and deletes.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by the label's numeric id.
terraform import flightdeck_label.security 23
```
